disk.description: The raw device used to access the disk which contains the NTFS partition to rescue files from.

start.description: The beginning of the NTFS partition in sectors.

end.description: The end of the NTFS partition in sectors.

output_dir.description: Directory to put rescued files in.

mft_offset.description: The location of the MFT from the beginning of the partition in sectors. If empty, no directory information can be used.

cluster_size.description: The cluster size in sectors. If empty, defaults to 8.
